Play a sound when rest is over
This phone has no sound picker, so the notification sound is used.
The day log, sets, the rest timer and the workout timer
The day log is home. Use ‹ and › or swipe to move between days, and Calendar to jump to any date.

Tap + to open the exercise library and pick an exercise. Its Track tab logs sets: enter the weight and reps (or distance and time), then **Save**. Tap a saved set to change or delete it. Each set has its own comment button and a done checkbox.
The alarm clock in the top bar starts the rest timer; while it runs, its countdown replaces the icon. The workout drawer lists the day\'s exercises, so you can move between them mid-workout.
The History and Graph tabs show every earlier session of the exercise.
Groups of exercises by day, added in one go
A workout is a set of exercises grouped into days you name, such as \"Push Day\" or \"Monday\". From the day log\'s ⋮ menu, **Add workout** adds a whole day\'s exercises and its planned sets at once.
**Create workout from this day** turns what you logged into a workout to repeat. **Copy workout** copies a day to another date.
Notes on the day, on an exercise or on one set

A workout comment is about the whole day. An exercise comment is a longer note on that exercise in the workout: the last one is shown the next time you log the exercise, and every one is in its History.
Each set also has its own comment, from the speech-bubble button on its row.
Bodyweight, body fat and your own measurements

Open it from the day log\'s ⋮ menu. Track lists each measurement with its latest value and change; tap one to log a value. History and Graph show them over time, and the pencil edits the list of measurements.
On an exercise graph, the ⋮ menu can draw a body measurement over the graph on its own scale, and the Relative Strength graph divides your estimated 1RM by your bodyweight.
Importing, poses, comparing and the slideshow
Open Photos from the day log\'s ⋮ menu. **+** imports photos; the ⋮ menu imports a whole folder and checks photo dates. Each photo can have a pose (front, side, back or other).
Open a photo to view it full screen, or compare two photos side by side. Tapping a point on a training graph shows the progress photo nearest that date.
The ▶ button plays a slideshow, which can be saved as a video in Movies/FlexNotes. Settings → Progress Photos & Media sets the defaults.
A printable summary of your training and photos
Settings → Backup and restore → **Create PDF report** makes a report with dark or light pages and up to four photos per day. It\'s made on your phone.
Keeping your data safe, on your phone only
Settings → Backup and restore saves or shares a .flexnotes backup with everything: workouts, body values, photos and settings. Restore replaces what\'s on the phone, after a safety copy.
Automatic backups go to a folder you choose, daily or weekly. Nothing is ever uploaded: FlexNotes has no account, no cloud service and no internet permission.
Settings → Import from FitNotes merges a FitNotes backup into FlexNotes. Imports only add what\'s missing: they never wipe or overwrite anything you\'ve logged in FlexNotes.
You can import again at any time, or let FlexNotes sync a FitNotes backup folder.
Totals, breakdowns, records and pinned graphs
Open Analysis from the day log\'s ⋮ menu: Workouts totals, a Breakdown by category or exercise, every exercise\'s graphs, goals and a records board.
Every graph can be drawn as a line, bar, area or step chart, opened full screen to zoom, given a trend, compared with other exercises and pinned to the Analysis overview with the star.

FlexNotes reads from Health Connect only the types you switch to it here: steps; the calories, protein, fat and carbs you ate; active calories burned; bodyweight and body fat; resting heart rate; sleep; and exercise sessions. It reads them on this phone and keeps them in FlexNotes\'s own data and your backups. It writes to Health Connect only what you switch on under Write to Health Connect: your bodyweight, body fat and workouts. Nothing is sent anywhere: FlexNotes has no internet permission. Values already read stay if you switch a type back, and values already written stay in Health Connect, where you can delete them.
